description: Wrecks can be cut apart with hull cutters into panels of alloys and containers of salvage, which a salvager then takes apart into the hold. Salvaging recovers metal scrap and alloys along with the usual parts, a Field Reclaimer turns a hull straight into minerals, and NPC scavengers carry alloys in their cargo.

fields.label: Cutters and salvagers in NPC loot
fields.description: Hull cutters and salvagers join the module pools of the game's loot tables and drop as often as any other module. Turn this off and NPCs never drop them.

fields.label: Alloys from wrecks
fields.description: Alloys from salvaging a wreck and from the cargo of NPC scavengers and haulers. A hull cutter still frees the metal in a hull when this is off.

fields.label: Salvage success bonus (percentage points)
fields.description: Added to the chance of every salvage attempt.

fields.label: Empty wreck chance (% of base game)
fields.description: How often a wreck salvages empty, as a share of the base game's chance. 100 is the base game.

fields.label: Metal scrap (multiplier)
fields.description: Scales the chance of Metal Scraps, Reinforced Metal Scraps and extra salvaged parts from a salvaged wreck. 0 turns them off.

fields.label: Salvaged alloys (multiplier)
fields.description: Scales the chance of the alloy roll on a salvaged wreck. 0 turns that roll off and leaves the hull alloys.

fields.label: Hull metal recovered by a salvager (%)
fields.description: The share of a hull's minerals that comes back as alloys when you salvage a wreck you have not cut. At 0 the hull's metal waits for a cutter.

fields.label: Salvage Hold first
fields.description: Salvage, alloys and scrap go to the Salvage Hold before the cargo hold.

fields.label: Hull metal a cutter can free (%)
fields.description: The share of a hull's minerals that forms alloys under a perfect cutter. Each cutter reaches its own part of it.

fields.label: Cutting speed (multiplier)
fields.description: Scales the wreck HP every cutter cuts per cycle.

fields.label: Salvage containers per cut wreck
fields.description: How many containers a cut wreck drops its salvaged parts in along the way.

fields.label: Cut wreck lifetime (minutes)
fields.description: Every cut keeps the wreck in space at least this long, so a slow job on a big hull is not lost.
